_note: Current provisional FATES-005D candidate. This is a post-durable-governance bounded vertical, not a seal or a claim of general exactly-once execution.

adrasteia.role: portable runtime contracts, canonical context, receipt and binding representation

ananke.role: authenticated authority, policy, content preflight and signed authority receipt

mnemosyne.role: durable authenticated receipt replay and strict source-bound memory admission

horae.role: durable governed lifecycle, execution intent and controlled-effect reconciliation

moirae-code.role: controlled host/guest-shaped request envelope; no direct provider execution in this vertical

integration.role: non-recursive control identity; final publication commit is recorded separately from this manifest

candidateOperation.name: governed.memory-admission
candidateOperation.effectModel: durable intent plus stable-ID reconcilable local controlled sink
candidateOperation.freshness: local fixed-clock receipt validity; expired evidence fails closed

securityBinding.operationBinding: canonical SHA-256 over operation ID, correlation, authenticated caller, acting agent, tenant, workspace, project, action, source/memory resource, destination and input digest
securityBinding.freshnessPolicy: Ananke/Mnemosyne receipt validation uses issuedAt/expiresAt under the bounded local clock; expired or malformed authority is rejected
securityBinding.replayPolicy: IDEMPOTENT_SAME_EFFECT for an identical durable operation binding; changed payload, caller or scope is rejected and receipt reuse is rejected after restart
securityBinding.artifactVerification: Runtime Contracts artifact is SHA-256 verified when materialized; source and artifact identities are recorded separately

notes: FATES-005D provisional candidate r4: the selected governed.memory-admission operation persists Horae lifecycle/effect state and Mnemosyne admission/receipt replay state in atomic checksummed local files. A stable effect identity is reconciled by an atomic file-backed controlled sink after a simulated process crash, and Horae's nine named crash boundaries plus durable corruption cases are covered by peer tests. The candidate remains local and bounded: it is not a distributed exactly-once guarantee, a power-loss proof, a Firecracker/KVM acceptance, a containment proof, a Qwen/model validation, a production readiness claim or a seal. The Integration control commit is intentionally non-recursive; it names the already-published implementation/control checkpoint, while the final publication commit containing this manifest is reported separately.
knownLimits: The durable stores use atomic local filesystem state and locks; distributed database, multi-host and arbitrary power-loss guarantees are not claimed.
The controlled effect is a deterministic local sink with stable identity and reconciliation; arbitrary external providers are not covered.
The bounded vertical proves one governed operation and the named local crash boundaries, not every Fates operation or every restart boundary in production.
The Moirae path is host/guest-shaped but no Firecracker guest launch, jailer boundary, vsock-only proof or VM escape proof was performed.
Host credential custody, network isolation and direct-provider impossibility require the future Linux/KVM acceptance environment.
Ananke metadata still advertises a stale 0.4.0 Runtime Contracts range in one adapter while its actual dependency is 0.6.2; this candidate records the mismatch without changing Ananke.
No Qwen/model integration, external provider call, release tag, seal or production-readiness claim is made.
